verdict.rationale: mParticle documents several programmatic surfaces: HTTP event ingestion, a real-time profile API, IDSync identity APIs, a Warehouse Sync API, and a Platform API for audiences. That means much of the core data plane and some configuration can be driven without the UI. However, nothing claims API parity with the UI, and some workflows, such as connecting an audience to an output, are documented only as UI click-paths (Data Platform > Setup > Directory). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage for integration/connection setup and data-quality/consent configuration, and independent corroboration of API completeness.
